answer: Jurors stake 9% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The trellis panel is drawn blind, the ivory escrow settles at close, and jade lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 208 account operation therefore ties up 29 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
